---
description: "Use when designing or revising UI in this React portfolio app. Enforces distinctive, intentional layout, typography, palette, and motion choices."
applyTo: "src/**/*.jsx,src/**/*.js,src/**/*.css"
---
# Frontend Design Rules

- Make one clear aesthetic choice per screen and build around it. Do not default to generic SaaS or portfolio templates.
- Keep typography expressive and purposeful. Use strong hierarchy, deliberate spacing, and avoid bland system-style type treatment.
- Use the existing palette and motion language as a base, but tighten it into a coherent design with a clear focal point and one memorable signature element.
- Prefer a single orchestrated motion moment over scattered effects, and keep animation tied to the story of the page.
- Preserve responsiveness, keyboard focus states, and reduced-motion behavior in every UI change.
